verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense documents creating virtual cards through its API and describes 'smart, flexible cards' with controlled transactions. Nothing in the evidence shows those cards can be locked to a single vendor or merchant, so vendor-level isolation from shared credit is unproven. missing for 10: documented single-vendor/merchant locking of virtual cards, per-subscription card creation workflow, spend limits per card, independent or hands-on corroboration.
